### [`draw_screen_source`](../../../../src/data/draw_screen_copy.asm#L6) `$7B58-$7C90`

*data*

The cold start copies $7B58-$7D57 to $9E00-$9FFF. These first $139 bytes are code that runs only at $9E00 (space bank1 holds the copy). The copy also takes the code from $7C91, which runs in place too.
